english.note: Use this when the emphasis is on evidence or an action causing A to believe B, rather than on persuading A as an interaction.

exampleSentences.english: The data in the report is enough to convince me that what he said is true.
exampleSentences.traditional: 份報告入面嘅數據令到我相信佢講嘅係真嘅。
